Tessa / Dev — looked over the cohort packet. Two quick internal notes:

1) Credit sizing: for partner cohorts we typically do either a small per-team stipend (e.g., $500–$2,000) or a capped cohort uplift (flat $X to be shared). Given Studio Well's reputation and expected traffic spike, I lean toward a capped cohort stipend to avoid surprise overages.

2) Approvals & T&Cs: Finance prefers a short addendum (one page) that:
   - caps total concessional credits granted to the cohort,
   - specifies they’re promotional (non-refundable, non-transferable), and
   - outlines basic acceptable use (no high-risk PII ingestion, retention policy).

I’ve attached a small usage snapshot from a similar partner cohort (see usage_snapshot.csv) as a baseline. Dev — can you run numbers on a capped uplift with the following options?
- Option A: $5,000 cohort stipend (split across applying teams) + 30-day onboarding waiver
- Option B: $7,500 cohort stipend + per-team cap of $1,500 and 14-day onboarding waiver

If Finance signs off on one of these, legal will just need the MOU addendum language and we can send a DocuSign.

—Marissa
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Studio Founders Allowance — supplemental credits question

Marissa / Tessa — ran the scenario against expected consumption and revenue impact. My take: Option B is reasonable for a one-off cohort uplift for a trusted partner. Details to operationalize:

- Cohort stipend: $7,500 total credits applied as account-level promotional credits to a single partner-owned ledger. Teams will draw from that pool until the cap is reached.
- Per-team safeguard: automatically enforce a $1,500 per-team spend cap (tag by team billing alias).
- Onboarding waiver: 14 days of waived overage charges; after that, standard billing applies or teams can move to an agreed paid plan.
- Audit & monitoring: partner program manager (Tessa) to receive weekly usage snapshot during the first month.

Implementation items: finance needs a short MOU (we can use the standard partner addendum template), create a deal record RDW-ACCT-4792, and generate a DocuSign for the addendum. I’ll prepare the promo code and the ledger once legal signs.

Link: https://app.redwood.ai/portal/deals/RDW-ACCT-4792 (I created the draft deal)

—Dev
Pricing Operations | Redwood Inference
